about: S-client-detail-a - the frame data of client-detail-1 and the undrawn states of the client page (/coach/clients/:id: the page, the Terv and Üzenetek tabs, the equipment editor; PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Account C = coach@ for every state, on the link of M (user@, {linkOfMember}). Every state is replay: the page's GETs (/clients, /clients/1, /clients/1/onboarding, /plans, /taxonomies, /conversations, /conversations/1/messages) are recorded. Every fixture is an edit list over the recording of the same endpoint, or a mutation outcome / stub with an empty or error-envelope body (R26). Nothing is written live by these states: the equipment save is answered by its fixture in the browser.

client-detail-1.why: The recording is Teszt Elek (TE) with the six drawn chips lit, 15 sessions in 28 days, 4 a week, one plan; the frame is drawn for Takács Dániel (TD), a plan started 2026-07-13 and a knee limitation that is 'caution' with a full sentence. The edits set the drawn name and the drawn start date; the note stays the client's recorded word "meniszkusz" (pulse-fixture-check refuses the drawn sentence: an identifier-like value no recording holds), and the severity stays the recorded 'avoid' when pulse-fixture-check refuses 'caution' for this endpoint (no recording of GET /clients/:id/onboarding holds it), so the value reads 'Térd — Kerülendő' in the warning ink instead of 'Térd — Óvatosan' in ink.

cd-recorded.title: Kliens adatlap — a felvett adatokkal (Teszt Elek)
cd-recorded.why: the recording exactly as it is: TE, the avoid limitation with the client's own word 'meniszkusz', the plan started 2026-07-20. The second structure check of the frame.

cd-handover-pending.title: Kliens adatlap — átadás függőben (a jelszót még az edző ismeri)
cd-handover-pending.why: must_change_credentials = 1: the monogram's full stop turns warn and is named, the handover notice line stands under the team line

cd-sheet.title: Kliens adatlap — Teljes kérdőív (lap)
cd-sheet.why: the questionnaire sheet: ten answers as rows, the flagged area with its warn dot, the client's notes

cd-clone-open.title: Kliens adatlap — Klónozás nyitva (sablonok a helyükön)
cd-clone-open.why: the template list opens inline under the link, every template with its day count

cd-plan-empty.title: Kliens adatlap — Terv: a kliensnek nincs terve
cd-plan-empty.why: the client's one plan removed from GET /plans: the left-aligned empty state, then the pill and the Klónozás link; the Terv stat reads 0

cd-plan-no-start.title: Kliens adatlap — Terv: kezdőnap nélküli terv
cd-plan-no-start.why: a plan with no start date generates nothing: the meta line is replaced by the warn line plans.needsStart

cd-equipment-changed.title: Kliens adatlap — felszerelés módosítva, Mentés él
cd-equipment-changed.why: one chip toggled on: the lime mark lands under Kettlebell, Mentés in the section head is enabled (the script scrolls to the end before the clicks, so that a chip never sits under the fixed tab bar at 874 pt, and back to the top before the shot)

cd-equipment-saved.title: Kliens adatlap — felszerelés mentve (visszajelzés)
cd-equipment-saved.why: the save is answered 200 by the fixture in the browser (nothing reaches the server, nobody is notified): the draft is cleared, Mentés is off again and the toast band says Felszerelés mentve (the toast is transient: the arrival is the settled section head) (the script scrolls to the end before the clicks, so that a chip never sits under the fixed tab bar at 874 pt, and back to the top before the shot)

cd-equipment-failed.title: Kliens adatlap — felszerelés mentése nem sikerült
cd-equipment-failed.why: the save is answered 500 by the fixture: the danger notice line under the chips, the draft kept, Mentés still enabled for a retry (the script scrolls to the end before the clicks, so that a chip never sits under the fixed tab bar at 874 pt, and back to the top before the shot)

cd-chat-tab.title: Kliens adatlap — Üzenetek fül
cd-chat-tab.why: the fourth view: the door to the full conversation and the embedded ChatPanel (recorded conversation 1)

cd-offline.title: Kliens adatlap — offline
cd-offline.why: the network drops after the page is drawn: the shell's offline line, the pill and Klónozás disabled (plan writes are guarded; equipment save is not, as today)

cd-missing.title: Kliens adatlap — a kliens nem érhető el
cd-missing.why: the server answers 404 for not yours / archived / never existed alike: the empty state is the page's h1, the way back a text link

notCapturable.page-loading: replay answers instantly; the skeleton (back row, monogram block, name block, three numeral blocks) is code-only - structure
notCapturable.answers-loading / equipment-loading / pl: the same: code-only skeleton blocks - structure
notCapturable.no-questionnaire: needs profile: null on GET /clients/:id/onboarding; no recording holds it (fixture-check refuses the type) - code only, structure
notCapturable.draft-questionnaire / several flagged ar: needs status 'draft' on the same endpoint; no recording holds it - code only, structure
notCapturable.creating / cloning busy: a held answer is not available in the capture tool - code only
